issue: Eight AMM differential runners read the captured pump_amm image, the captured dependency ELFs, the captured trade/migration fixtures and the AMM source tree, then truncated --output with write_text. Passing an input as --output destroyed captured evidence, or replaced the executing script with its own report.
affected: scripts/pump_amm_{boost_burn,cashback,create,creator_reassignment_cto,creator_reassignment,incentives,migration_create,transfer_creator}_differential.py at base; each writer is the last statement of its main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 32 failing subtests in 5 tests. --output on the captured image overwrote it, and --output on the runner itself replaced the module with the report so the next import failed. The AMM family's already-admitted siblings (pump_amm_liquidity, pump_amm_admin, pump_amm_collect, ...) publish through scripts/pump_differential_output.py: PumpReport.

change.publisher: PumpReport(output, ROOT, candidate, pathlib.Path(__file__), extra_inputs=AMM_REPORT_INPUTS) built before any case executes, and before pin_program replaces the candidate path (migration_create, creator_reassignment_cto)
change.report_inputs: AMM_REPORT_INPUTS in pump_amm_reusable_harness.py: the captured amm-v2-trade-fixture, curve-migrate-v2 and curve-fresh-trades-v3 fixtures plus the programs/pump-amm source tree; the captured images, dependency ELFs, candidate and executing script are protected by PumpReport itself
change.failure: ValueError: report output aliases an input: <path>, exit 1, before a case runs and before any output directory is created

runs.case_payload_unchanged: base and proposed runners were run with the same candidate and inputs; every report is identical after ignoring the script hashes that necessarily change (script_sha256 and hashed script paths). Case counts: create 246, migration_create 37, transfer_creator 267, creator_reassignment 327, cashback 146, boost_burn 506, creator_reassignment_cto 159, incentives sync (family sync), all with no mismatches
runs.alias_refusals: 32 refusals exercised by the new test (captured image, candidate, captured fixture, executing script, for each of the eight runners); each exits non-zero with the alias message and leaves the target bytes unchanged
runs.publication_control: each runner publishes a fresh nested receipt: mismatch-free JSON, case_count > 0, and no staging file left beside it

tests.before: 32 failing subtests in 5 tests against the base scripts (71.8s)

unchanged: captured ELFs, dependency ELFs and captured fixtures
the AMM harness's runtime behaviour (a module constant is added)
not_claimed: The controls prove admission and publication on synthetic local fixtures; they do not re-run the full AMM differential corpus from a clean checkout and make no byte-identity claim about the rebuilt program.
